levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Packs items unrelated to tomorrow's plan, or leaves out more than one required item.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Packs all items tomorrow's plan requires, with at most one item added at the morning check.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Packs all required items the night before with nothing missing at the morning check, and can explain why each item was chosen.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Most of the packing happens the morning of, not the night before.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The bag is fully packed and placed by the door the night before.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The bag is fully packed the night before, and the learner checks the weather or asks an adult about it without being reminded.

lookFors: The learner checks tomorrow's specific plan before selecting items, rather than packing from habit alone.
The reflection names one specific previously forgotten item, not a general statement about being more prepared.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
